one_line_reason: Pre-revenue MVP in a real but crowded market — 10,000 free users, $8.99 all-time revenue, 0 paid subscribers, and a misleading '4.2x' multiple that is arithmetically false; a turnaround call option at $449, not a cash-flow acquisition.

operability_upside.note: React + Dodo Payments stack is in-wheelhouse; real engineering upside (API, LMS integrations, better AI, conversion funnel)

pmf_retention.note: VERIFIED POOR: 0 active subscriptions, $8.99 all-time, 0% paid conversion on ~10,000 free users in 15 months

unit_economics.note: No paying customers; SaaS model would have strong economics if it converted, but verified non-functional

moat_defensibility.note: Crowded field: Certifier.io, Accredible, Sertifier, CertifyMe, Credly all established; AI features are table stakes; QR verification not unique

growth_market.note: Digital credential market real and growing; AI tailwind; but Certifyr has captured none of it

tech_ip.note: 628 GitHub commits; 0 in last 30 days; React stack; no repo access; IP ownership unconfirmed — neutral pending verification

transfer_key_person.note: Founder has 4 X followers; growth is product-led/freemium; distribution is impersonal and transfers with asset

deal_terms.note: Extremely affordable ($449 / $10k budget); but '4.2x multiple' is false ($449/$8.99 = ~50x all-time); buying code + users, not cash flow; open to offers

seller_adverse_selection.note: Red flags: false multiple claim; listed day after only transaction; '0 bugs' oversell; abandoned development (0 commits/30d); thin exit story on $8.99 business

key_unknowns: Why 10,000 free users produced zero paid conversions — fixable funnel vs. market rejection (PMF/unit-economics; if fixable, score +5–8 pts; if market rejection, move toward PASS)
IP/code ownership — is 100% owned and freely transferable by the seller? (IP gate; if false, caps at MARGINAL regardless)
Free user quality — real active signups or bots/one-time visitors? (PMF/moat; if mostly bots, asset value near zero)
Full asset transfer scope — which accounts/handles/repos actually convey? (transfer/key-person gate)
Actual monthly operating costs (hosting, AI API calls, email) — could make operations unviable even at $449 entry
seller_questions: Why have 10,000 free users produced zero paying customers? What conversion tactics did you try and what were the results? [D2/D3 — this is the central unknown]
Is 100% of the code and all assets owned by you and freely transferable (no contractor IP, no expiring licenses)? [IP gate]
What is the quality of the 10,000 estimated users? Signups by month, DAU/MAU, feature usage breakdown? [D2/D4]
Can you share 30-90 day active user data from your analytics tool? [D2]
What accounts/assets are included: domain, hosting, GitHub repo(s), Dodo Payments account, social handles, email list, analytics accounts? [D7/IP gate]
What are the true monthly operating costs (hosting, AI/API, email, other)? [D3]
What would you do to grow this if you kept it? Where is the biggest conversion opportunity? [D9]
